title: 恐龙为什么不见了
subtitle: 天上掉下来的那块石头
character: wearing a deep indigo t-shirt, grey shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, bold oil pastel strokes with visible texture, deep indigo, ember orange and ash grey

pages.zh:
我问爸爸，
恐龙去哪儿了？
爸爸说，
很久很久以前的一天，
天上掉下来一块石头。
pages.scene: The little boy sits on the floor with a toy dinosaur in one hand, seen close from the front so his face is large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, his mouth open asking a question; his father sits beside him.

pages.zh:
那块石头很大，
有一座山那么大。
它从天上直直砸下来，
落在海边，
砸出一个大坑。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one round rock shape and one mountain outline side by side on a cream background, the same height. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
撞的那一下，
地面抖了起来，
海水推成一道大浪，
附近的树
全都倒了。
pages.scene: One huge wave rolling over a shore with trees bending flat on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
最要命的不是那一下。
是撞起来的灰尘
飘到天上，
铺成厚厚一层，
把太阳遮住了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one sun at the top of a cream background, one thick horizontal band of dust below it, and light arrows stopping at the band. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
太阳照不下来，
地上就冷了。
一冷就是好多年，
连白天
也是灰灰的。
pages.scene: A cold landscape filling the whole picture from edge to edge: bare grey ground under a flat ash grey sky, a few bare tree trunks standing, everything the same dull grey.

pages.zh:
没有太阳，
植物就长不出来。
植物死了，
吃植物的恐龙
跟着没饭吃。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: four shapes in a row on a cream background joined by arrows: a sun, a plant, a plant-eating dinosaur, a meat-eating dinosaur, with a cross drawn over the sun. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
个子大的最吃亏。
它每天要吃那么多，
现在一点也找不到，
没过多久
就撑不住了。
pages.scene: One very large dinosaur standing alone on bare ground with its head lowered on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
谁活下来了呢？
个子小的，
吃得少的，
能钻进洞里的，
能吃种子和虫子的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: a cream background split into two columns, the left column holding three very large animal silhouettes each with a cross over it, the right column holding three small animal silhouettes with no cross. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有一小支恐龙
身上长着羽毛，
个子小，会飞。
它们活了下来，
就是今天的鸟。
pages.scene: One small feathered dinosaur flying up from a bare branch on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
恐龙在地球上
住了一亿六千万年。
人住了多久呢？
和它们比起来，
还不到细细的一条线。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one very long horizontal bar on a cream background and, beneath its right end, one extremely short bar starting from the same right edge. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
那一天
在地里留下了记号。
地层中间有一条灰线，
线下面有恐龙，
线上面，一只也没有了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one cross-section of stacked ground layers on a cream background with one thin dark line across the middle, three small dinosaur shapes embedded below the line and none above it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我看着窗外的麻雀。
它跳了两下，
飞走了。
爸爸说，
那也是恐龙。
pages.scene: The little boy kneels on a chair at a window and turns his head back towards the viewer with a smile, his face large in the frame, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight; one small sparrow sits on the window sill behind him.
